text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: ENS's forecast, upsampled to hourly by three techniques: native steps, linear interpolation, and speed and direction both taken from the interpolated eastward and northward wind components. Bottom: what the generator produced that day.'

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Squares mark ENS's own native steps. The panels pair the same calendar day at day 1 and at day 7, chosen by rule from measured output alone: the day with the largest range. Generator not named. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, every hour, August 2024 to September 2026. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.'
